19087aaf3f452985681e3d88f7123518.overview: A young Donald Trump, eager to make his name as a hungry scion of a wealthy family in 1970s New York, comes under the spell of Roy Cohn, the cutthroat attorney who would help create the Donald Trump we know today. Cohn sees in Trump the perfect protégé—someone with raw ambition, a hunger for success, and a willingness to do whatever it takes to win.

190af9e3136565d470ef4ae59afc4c5d.overview: With the help of a German bounty hunter, a freed slave sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal Mississippi plantation owner.
190af9e3136565d470ef4ae59afc4c5d.tagline: Life, liberty, and the pursuit of vengeance.

193922c88768985d740d1e6dfce56945.overview: Copenhagen, Denmark, 1962. When a high-ranking Soviet official decides to change sides, a French intelligence agent is caught up in a cold, silent and bloody spy war in which his own family will play a decisive role.
193922c88768985d740d1e6dfce56945.tagline: Hitchcock takes you behind the actual headlines to expose the most explosive spy scandal of this century!

196eab2785416bec971f4f1af06cd488.overview: A feudal epic presenting the tale of a petty thief who is recruited to impersonate Shingen, an aging warlord, in order to avoid attacks by competing clans. The impostor becomes comfortable living his life among nobility, but his responsibilities to his station grow more demanding the longer he occupies it.
196eab2785416bec971f4f1af06cd488.tagline: The Shadow of a man can never stand up and walk on its own.

19735c0c73bbdddd99f7d227b86d6078.overview: Sailor Joe Hart, who is spending his shore leave at a gambling joint, sells his gun to young Laurie Roberts after losing terribly. After Hart again loses his last dime, he leaves the joint and steals a car in order to return to his ship. Later that night, a tough gambler named "The Weasel" convinces Laurie, who also lost badly, that Baldy, the joint's owner, is crooked, and they both return to the joint to break open the safe. During the holdup, The Weasel kills Baldy with Joe's gun and, after being picked up for speeding, Joe is arrested for murder.

197a51c542be104fb6a540de511a10b0.overview: A man tries to find a son he gave up for adoption years ago.
197a51c542be104fb6a540de511a10b0.tagline: TOGETHER and TERRIFIC! ...in a story of unforgettable warmth and impact!

19821dec8197e877bdb2c947ed01926b.overview: In 1990s Los Angeles, a 13-year-old spends his summer navigating between a troubled home life and a crew of new friends he meets at a skate shop.

1999501537b9d65aca6f79908e99fcec.overview: Young Charlie begins to develop cold feet as his wedding looms nearer. Desperate to throw the plans off-track, he tries a variety of tactics, including attempting to rekindle the relationship between his fiancée, Josephine, and her former boyfriend.
1999501537b9d65aca6f79908e99fcec.tagline: You are cordially invited to join the confusion at...

19a482e82992fb36c40cee6fa6d24acb.overview: Eliza D'Amico thinks her marriage to Louis is going great until she finds a mysterious love note to her husband. Concerned, she goes to her mother for advice. Eliza, her parents, her sister Jo, and Jo's boyfriend all pile into the station wagon and go to the city to confront Louis with the letter. On the way, the five explore their relations with each other and meet many interesting people.
